title: a heterogeneous literal does not satisfy @int
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: The contract makes this an error without fixing the detection stage (spec 6.3: a static pass may diagnose boundary mismatches before execution). The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 6.6.2: a heterogeneous literal without an explicit @any boundary is rejected (#315), so it never reaches @int.
